title: Unit capacities count disjoint paths
notes: With every capacity 1, the maximum flow is the largest number of paths from s to t that share no arc. Here it is 3: s has three arcs out, and the cut finds three arcs that every path must use.
ops: s>a, s>b, s>c, a>d, b>d, b>e, c>e, d>t, e>t, c>f, f>t
